name: orc
description: Full-SDLC Claude Code plugin — plan → implement → QA → ship → CI → release, with root-cause debugging, incident response, and dependency care. Hook-enforced guardrails, curated skills, model/effort-tuned agents.

pr_size_budget.title: PR size budget (LOC)
pr_size_budget.description: Soft LOC budget per PR (additions+deletions, post-exclusion) enforced by the ship/flow/stack-pr gate

protected_branches.title: Protected branches
protected_branches.description: Comma-separated branch names guarded by the confirm-to-commit hook

skip_tool_check.title: Skip tool check
skip_tool_check.description: Skip the SessionStart CLI dependency pre-flight

learn_from_outcomes.title: Learn from outcomes
learn_from_outcomes.description: Record verified debug outcomes into the local Graphify work-memory (graphify-out/, git-ignored) so code discovery improves across sessions. No effect when Graphify is absent.

interaction_policy.title: Interaction policy
interaction_policy.description: Default autopilot level for inward gates: manual (every gate asks), guided (mechanical confirms auto-advance), auto (sprint contract; phases run autonomously against agreed criteria). Outward-facing gates (tracker writes, PR review posting, evidence publish) always ask regardless.

statusline.title: Statusline
statusline.description: Render the orc statusline (session, phase, branch, PR, context, cost). false hides it even with the plugin-shipped default installed.

statusline_style.title: Statusline style
statusline_style.description: full (two lines, width-aware) or compact (always a single dense line)

statusline_context_reserve.title: Statusline context reserve (%)
statusline_context_reserve.description: 0-50. When >0, the context percentage is normalized against this reserved slice (e.g. your auto-compact reserve) and rendered with a ~ prefix. 0 shows the raw payload percentage.
